items.title: NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR
items.contentSnippet:
Open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array RADAR system

    
 
AERIS-10: Open Source Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated Phased Array Radar
 
     
 
AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system featuring Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated (LFM) modulation. Available in two versions (3km and 20km range), it's designed for researchers, drone developers, and serious SDR enthusiasts who want to explore and experiment with phased array radar technology.

items.title: Show HN: Text alerts when Codex resets are announced
items.contentSnippet:
I built this out of my usage limit frustration in Codex.
OpenAI had started announcing more resets (which helped), but I often didn't see them until my usage had already refilled to 100%.
I wanted to know ASAP so I could burn through remaining usage before the reset.
So I built this text alert service that monitors X and sends text updates when a new Codex reset is announced.
It currently sends SMS alerts to users in the US and Canada, and Telegram alerts otherwise.

items.title: Show HN: An MCP to control other Windows computers
items.contentSnippet:
This an MCP for agents to connect to Windows computers headlessly. For this example repo, Claude is handling IT support tickets while I'm still working on my computer. It then requests my help with a ticket when it's stuck, and I connect right to that computer with Claude.
You could also use this as a render buddy that checks on your render jobs. Or you could use it to set up PCs for new users at your company. Lots of possibilities. Hopefully, this repo helps you get started with building them.

items.title: Show HN: Sensored – streaming-first PII/PHI redaction
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN  - I made this neat library to remove PII and other kinds of personal information from text without paying for a ML classifier. Sensored is mostly regex-based detection with features built-in to help steer LLMs to add stable anchors, light weight bloom filters + optional Jev classification, and more. It's also fast: ~0.0.8ms chat and ~12Mi/s for streaming.
